instructions.name: initialize_mint
instructions.title: Initialize mint
instructions.rationale: Initializes a freshly allocated mint account; cannot touch existing balances or authorities.
instructions.notes: PROGRAM-LEVEL NOTES FOR THIS FILE. (1) Base instructions carry a 1-byte tag at data[0]; disc8 = tag + 7 zero bytes. (2) Extension instructions (tags 26,27,28,30,33,34,36,37,39,40,41,42,43,44,46) are TWO bytes on the wire: extension tag, then sub-tag, then args. The program rejects an extension tag with no sub-tag, so this file has no standalone entry for those 15 tags; every sub-instruction is listed with rawPrefixHex = both bytes and disc8 = [tag, sub-tag, 6 zero bytes] (registry convention; integrators must report this 2-byte form). Sub-tag 0 therefore has the same disc8 as the plain 1-byte value of its tag, so a reporter that sends only the first byte would resolve every sub-instruction of that extension to its sub-tag-0 entry. (3) Nine token-metadata and token-group interface instructions use 8-byte hash discriminators (first 8 bytes of sha256 of namespace:name); rawPrefixHex = disc8, and none starts with a valid tag byte (0-46, 255), so dispatch is unambiguous. (4) batch (tag 255) can wrap any other instruction. (5) Deployment checked 2026-10-10: the mainnet-beta ELF is byte-identical to release program@v11.0.0 and the devnet ELF to program@v11.1.0; tags, sub-tags and layouts are identical in both. The program is upgradeable (upgrade authority set on both clusters). THIS ENTRY: Tag 0 (TokenInstruction::InitializeMint). Data: decimals u8 @1, mint authority @2..34, freeze authority option @34 (flag, then pubkey). Must share a transaction with the System create_account that allocates the mint. Needs the Rent sysvar (see initialize_mint2). Accounts: mint (w), Rent sysvar.

instructions.name: initialize_account
instructions.title: Initialize token account
instructions.rationale: Initializes a freshly allocated token account for a mint and owner; moves no tokens and touches no existing balances.
instructions.notes: Tag 1 (TokenInstruction::InitializeAccount). Writes only the account being initialized; must share a transaction with the System create_account that allocates it. Accounts: account (w), mint, owner, Rent sysvar.

instructions.name: initialize_multisig
instructions.title: Initialize multisig
instructions.rationale: Initializes a new multisig account with M of N signers; changes no existing authority and moves no funds.
instructions.notes: Tag 2 (TokenInstruction::InitializeMultisig). m (required signers) u8 @1; the N signers (1..=11) follow as accounts. Accounts: multisig (w), Rent sysvar, signers.

instructions.name: transfer
instructions.title: Transfer (deprecated)
instructions.rationale: Deprecated unchecked transfer of tokens from an owner or delegate account to a destination account chosen by the caller.
instructions.notes: Tag 3 (TokenInstruction::Transfer). Deprecated in favor of transfer_checked and transfer_checked_with_fee; fails if either account has the TransferFeeAmount extension. Owner or delegate signs. Accounts: source (w), destination (w), authority (s).

instructions.name: approve
instructions.title: Approve delegate
instructions.rationale: Authorizes a delegate to spend up to an amount from the source account.
instructions.notes: Tag 4 (TokenInstruction::Approve). The amount is the delegated allowance, not a transfer. Accounts: source (w), delegate, owner (s).

instructions.name: revoke
instructions.title: Revoke delegate
instructions.rationale: Clears the delegate on a token account; it only removes spending authority but still changes authority state.
instructions.notes: Tag 5 (TokenInstruction::Revoke). No instruction data. Accounts: source (w), owner or delegate (s).

instructions.name: set_authority
instructions.title: Set authority
instructions.rationale: Sets or clears an authority of a mint or token account: mint, freeze, owner, close, fee, hook, pause and others.
instructions.notes: Tag 6 (TokenInstruction::SetAuthority). authority_type u8 @1 (0 MintTokens, 1 FreezeAccount, 2 AccountOwner, 3 CloseAccount, 4 TransferFeeConfig, 5 WithheldWithdraw, 6 CloseMint, 7 InterestRate, 8 PermanentDelegate, 9 ConfidentialTransferMint, 10 TransferHookProgramId, 11 ConfidentialTransferFeeConfig, 12 MetadataPointer, 13 GroupPointer, 14 GroupMemberPointer, 15 ScaledUiAmount, 16 Pause, 17 PermissionedBurn), then the new authority as an option: flag @2, pubkey @3. AccountOwner hands the whole token account to the new authority. Accounts: mint or account (w), current authority (s).

instructions.name: mint_to
instructions.title: Mint to
instructions.rationale: Issuer power: mints new tokens to any token account, inflating supply; requires the mint authority.
instructions.notes: Tag 7 (TokenInstruction::MintTo). Creates supply instead of debiting an account, so it matters when the mandate owner is the mint authority. The native mint does not support minting. Classed admin (deny by default) rather than value_out; the amount offset is given so a cap can be applied if it is explicitly allowed. Accounts: mint (w), destination (w), mint authority (s).

instructions.name: burn
instructions.title: Burn
instructions.rationale: Destroys tokens from an owner or delegate account, an irreversible loss bounded by the amount.
instructions.notes: Tag 8 (TokenInstruction::Burn). Not supported on native (wrapped SOL) accounts; use close_account. Accounts: source (w), mint (w), owner or delegate (s).

instructions.name: close_account
instructions.title: Close token account
instructions.rationale: Closes a token account (or a mint with a close authority) and sends all its lamports to a caller-chosen destination.
instructions.notes: Tag 9 (TokenInstruction::CloseAccount). No instruction data. Non-native accounts must hold zero tokens; a native (wrapped SOL) account may be closed with a balance and its whole value goes to the destination. A close authority, if set, signs instead of the owner. A mint needs the MintCloseAuthority extension and zero supply. Accounts: account (w), destination (w), owner or close authority (s).

instructions.name: freeze_account
instructions.title: Freeze account
instructions.rationale: Issuer power: freezes a holder token account so its tokens cannot move; requires the mint freeze authority.
instructions.notes: Tag 10 (TokenInstruction::FreezeAccount). No instruction data. Mint-level power over other holders accounts. Accounts: account (w), mint, freeze authority (s).

instructions.name: thaw_account
instructions.title: Thaw account
instructions.rationale: Issuer power: unfreezes a frozen token account; requires the mint freeze authority.
instructions.notes: Tag 11 (TokenInstruction::ThawAccount). No instruction data. Accounts: account (w), mint, freeze authority (s).

instructions.name: transfer_checked
instructions.title: Transfer (checked)
instructions.rationale: Transfers tokens from an owner or delegate account to a destination chosen by the caller, verifying mint and decimals.
instructions.notes: Tag 12 (TokenInstruction::TransferChecked). decimals u8 @9. If either account has TransferFeeAmount the fee is withheld at the destination (transfer_checked_with_fee pins the expected fee). Accounts: source (w), mint, destination (w), owner or delegate (s).

instructions.name: approve_checked
instructions.title: Approve delegate (checked)
instructions.rationale: Authorizes a delegate to spend up to an amount from the source account, verifying mint and decimals.
instructions.notes: Tag 13 (TokenInstruction::ApproveChecked). The amount is the delegated allowance, not a transfer; decimals u8 @9. Accounts: source (w), mint, delegate, owner (s).

instructions.name: mint_to_checked
instructions.title: Mint to (checked)
instructions.rationale: Issuer power: mints new tokens to any token account, inflating supply, verifying decimals; requires the mint authority.
instructions.notes: Tag 14 (TokenInstruction::MintToChecked). decimals u8 @9. Same exposure and classification as mint_to. Accounts: mint (w), destination (w), mint authority (s).

instructions.name: burn_checked
instructions.title: Burn (checked)
instructions.rationale: Destroys tokens from an owner or delegate account, verifying decimals; an irreversible loss bounded by the amount.
instructions.notes: Tag 15 (TokenInstruction::BurnChecked). decimals u8 @9. Not supported on native (wrapped SOL) accounts; use close_account. Accounts: source (w), mint (w), owner or delegate (s).

instructions.name: initialize_account2
instructions.title: Initialize token account (v2)
instructions.rationale: Initializes a freshly allocated token account, taking the owner from instruction data; touches no existing funds.
instructions.notes: Tag 16 (TokenInstruction::InitializeAccount2). Owner pubkey @1..33. Accounts: account (w), mint, Rent sysvar.

instructions.name: sync_native
instructions.title: Sync native (wrapped SOL)
instructions.rationale: Updates a wrapped SOL account token amount to match its lamports; credits lamports already deposited and moves nothing.
instructions.notes: Tag 17 (TokenInstruction::SyncNative). No instruction data. Accounts: native token account (w).

instructions.name: initialize_account3
instructions.title: Initialize token account (v3)
instructions.rationale: Like initialize_account2 without the Rent sysvar; initializes a fresh token account and touches no existing funds.
instructions.notes: Tag 18 (TokenInstruction::InitializeAccount3). Owner pubkey @1..33. Accounts: account (w), mint.

instructions.name: initialize_multisig2
instructions.title: Initialize multisig (v2)
instructions.rationale: Like initialize_multisig without the Rent sysvar; initializes a new multisig, changing no existing authority and moving no funds.
instructions.notes: Tag 19 (TokenInstruction::InitializeMultisig2). m u8 @1; signers follow as accounts. Accounts: multisig (w), signers.

instructions.name: initialize_mint2
instructions.title: Initialize mint (v2)
instructions.rationale: Initializes a freshly allocated mint account; cannot touch existing balances or authorities.
instructions.notes: Tag 20 (TokenInstruction::InitializeMint2). Same data layout as initialize_mint. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: get_account_data_size
instructions.title: Get account data size
instructions.rationale: Query only: returns the token account size for a mint plus listed extensions through return data; changes no state.
instructions.notes: Tag 21 (TokenInstruction::GetAccountDataSize). Extension types (2 bytes each) follow the tag. Accounts: mint.

instructions.name: initialize_immutable_owner
instructions.title: Initialize immutable owner
instructions.rationale: Enables the ImmutableOwner extension on a fresh token account, which only restricts future owner changes.
instructions.notes: Tag 22 (TokenInstruction::InitializeImmutableOwner). No instruction data. Must run before the account is initialized. Accounts: account (w).

instructions.name: amount_to_ui_amount
instructions.title: Amount to UI amount
instructions.rationale: Query only: converts a raw token amount to a UI string through return data; changes no state.
instructions.notes: Tag 23 (TokenInstruction::AmountToUiAmount). The u64 @1 is a conversion input, not value moved, so no amount descriptor is given. For interest-bearing or scaled-UI mints the conversion uses floating-point math. Accounts: mint.

instructions.name: ui_amount_to_amount
instructions.title: UI amount to amount
instructions.rationale: Query only: converts a UI amount string to a raw token amount through return data; changes no state.
instructions.notes: Tag 24 (TokenInstruction::UiAmountToAmount). A UTF-8 string follows the tag; the result is a u64 LE in return data. Accounts: mint.

instructions.name: initialize_mint_close_authority
instructions.title: Initialize mint close authority
instructions.rationale: Assigns the authority that may later close a new mint; must run before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Tag 25 (TokenInstruction::InitializeMintCloseAuthority). Close authority option: flag @1, pubkey @2. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: initialize_transfer_fee_config
instructions.title: Transfer fee: initialize config
instructions.rationale: Sets the transfer fee rate, cap and fee authorities on a new mint; mint-level setup before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 26 (TokenInstruction::TransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 0 (TransferFeeInstruction::InitializeTransferFeeConfig); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data: config authority option, withdraw-withheld authority option, fee basis points u16, maximum fee u64. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: transfer_checked_with_fee
instructions.title: Transfer fee: transfer (checked, with fee)
instructions.rationale: Transfers tokens to any destination, verifying mint, decimals and the expected fee; signed by owner or delegate.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 26 (TokenInstruction::TransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 1 (TransferFeeInstruction::TransferCheckedWithFee); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Layout: amount u64 @2, decimals u8 @10, expected fee u64 @11 (the fee, not the principal). Accounts: source (w), mint, destination (w), owner or delegate (s).

instructions.name: withdraw_withheld_tokens_from_mint
instructions.title: Transfer fee: withdraw withheld from mint
instructions.rationale: Withdraws all fees withheld on the mint to any fee-receiver account; needs the withdraw-withheld authority; no amount to cap.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 26 (TokenInstruction::TransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 2 (TransferFeeInstruction::WithdrawWithheldTokensFromMint); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag, so the amount cannot be capped; denied by default. Accounts: mint (w), fee receiver (w), withdraw-withheld authority (s).

instructions.name: withdraw_withheld_tokens_from_accounts
instructions.title: Transfer fee: withdraw withheld from accounts
instructions.rationale: Withdraws all fees withheld on listed token accounts to any fee-receiver account; needs the withdraw-withheld authority; no amount to cap.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 26 (TokenInstruction::TransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 3 (TransferFeeInstruction::WithdrawWithheldTokensFromAccounts); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. num_token_accounts u8 @2; the source accounts follow the signers. No amount, so it cannot be capped; denied by default. Accounts: mint, fee receiver (w), withdraw-withheld authority (s), sources (w).

instructions.name: harvest_withheld_tokens_to_mint
instructions.title: Transfer fee: harvest withheld to mint
instructions.rationale: Permissionless: moves fees already withheld on token accounts into the mint; no owner funds are affected.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 26 (TokenInstruction::TransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 4 (TransferFeeInstruction::HarvestWithheldTokensToMint); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts without the TransferFeeAmount extension are skipped. Accounts: mint (w), source token accounts (w).

instructions.name: set_transfer_fee
instructions.title: Transfer fee: set fee
instructions.rationale: Changes the mint transfer fee rate and maximum fee; requires the transfer-fee config authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 26 (TokenInstruction::TransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 5 (TransferFeeInstruction::SetTransferFee); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data: fee basis points u16 @2, maximum fee u64 @4. Accounts: mint (w), config authority (s).

instructions.name: initialize_confidential_transfer_mint
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: initialize mint
instructions.rationale: Enables confidential transfers on a new mint, setting its authority, auto-approve flag and auditor key; run before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 0 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::InitializeMint); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: update_confidential_transfer_mint
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: update mint
instructions.rationale: Changes the auto-approve flag and auditor ElGamal key of a confidential-transfer mint; requires the confidential transfer authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 1 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::UpdateMint); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w), confidential transfer mint authority (s).

instructions.name: configure_confidential_transfer_account
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: configure account
instructions.rationale: Turns on confidential transfers for a token account and registers its ElGamal key; owner-signed configuration backed by a proof.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 2 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::ConfigureAccount); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Needs a pubkey-validity proof in the same transaction or a context account. Accounts: account (w), mint, instructions sysvar or proof context, owner (s).

instructions.name: approve_confidential_transfer_account
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: approve account
instructions.rationale: Approves a token account for confidential transfers; requires the confidential transfer mint authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 3 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::ApproveAccount); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Only needed when the mint requires approval of new accounts. Accounts: account (w), mint, confidential transfer mint authority (s).

instructions.name: empty_confidential_transfer_account
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: empty account
instructions.rationale: Resets the confidential available balance after a zero-balance proof, preparing the account to close; moves no value.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 4 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::EmptyAccount); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Needs a zero-ciphertext proof in the same transaction or a context account. Accounts: account (w), instructions sysvar or proof context, owner (s).

instructions.name: confidential_deposit
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: deposit
instructions.rationale: Moves tokens from a public balance into the same account confidential pending balance; funds stay under the owner.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 5 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::Deposit); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Layout: amount u64 @2, decimals u8 @10. Fails if the account is frozen, or the mint is non-transferable, paused or uses confidential mint/burn. Accounts: token account (w), mint, owner or delegate (s). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: confidential_withdraw
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: withdraw
instructions.rationale: Moves tokens from the confidential available balance back to the same account public balance; needs ZK proofs.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 6 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::Withdraw); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Layout: amount u64 @2, decimals u8 @10, then the new decryptable balance and two proof offsets (i8). Needs equality and range proofs. Accounts: token account (w), mint, proofs, owner (s). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: confidential_transfer
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: transfer
instructions.rationale: Transfers tokens confidentially to another account; the amount is encrypted so it cannot be read or capped from instruction data.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 7 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::Transfer); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data carries ciphertexts and proof offsets only, so a spend limit cannot be enforced from instruction data; denied by default. Accounts: source (w), mint, destination (w), proofs, owner (s). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: apply_confidential_pending_balance
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: apply pending balance
instructions.rationale: Rolls the pending confidential balance into the available balance of the same account; moves no value out.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 8 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::ApplyPendingBalance); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data: expected pending credit counter u64 @2, then the new decryptable balance. Accounts: account (w), owner (s). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: enable_confidential_credits
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: enable confidential credits
instructions.rationale: Account setting: lets the account receive incoming confidential transfers; owner-signed configuration.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 9 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::EnableConfidentialCredits); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Accounts: account (w), owner (s).

instructions.name: disable_confidential_credits
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: disable confidential credits
instructions.rationale: Account setting: makes the account reject incoming confidential transfers; owner-signed configuration.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 10 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::DisableConfidentialCredits); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Accounts: account (w), owner (s).

instructions.name: enable_non_confidential_credits
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: enable non-confidential credits
instructions.rationale: Account setting: lets a confidential account receive non-confidential transfers; owner-signed configuration.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 11 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::EnableNonConfidentialCredits); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Accounts: account (w), owner (s).

instructions.name: disable_non_confidential_credits
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: disable non-confidential credits
instructions.rationale: Account setting: makes a confidential account reject non-confidential transfers; owner-signed configuration.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 12 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::DisableNonConfidentialCredits); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Accounts: account (w), owner (s).

instructions.name: confidential_transfer_with_fee
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: transfer with fee
instructions.rationale: Transfers tokens confidentially with a fee; the amount is encrypted so it cannot be read or capped from instruction data.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 13 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::TransferWithFee); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data carries ciphertexts and five proof offsets only, so a spend limit cannot be enforced; denied by default. Accounts: source (w), mint, destination (w), proofs, owner (s). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: configure_confidential_transfer_account_with_registry
instructions.title: Confidential transfer: configure account (registry)
instructions.rationale: Configures a token account for confidential transfers from an ElGamal registry account, skipping the proof; may also fund a reallocation.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 27 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferExtension) + sub-tag 14 (ConfidentialTransferInstruction::ConfigureAccountWithRegistry); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. An optional payer and System program account can fund a reallocation. Accounts: account (w), mint, ElGamal registry, optional payer (w,s), optional System program.

instructions.name: initialize_default_account_state
instructions.title: Default account state: initialize
instructions.rationale: Sets the default state (such as frozen) of new token accounts for a new mint; setup before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 28 (TokenInstruction::DefaultAccountStateExtension) + sub-tag 0 (DefaultAccountStateInstruction::Initialize); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data: AccountState byte @2. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: update_default_account_state
instructions.title: Default account state: update
instructions.rationale: Changes the default state of new token accounts for a mint; requires the freeze authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 28 (TokenInstruction::DefaultAccountStateExtension) + sub-tag 1 (DefaultAccountStateInstruction::Update); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data: AccountState byte @2. Accounts: mint (w), freeze authority (s).

instructions.name: reallocate
instructions.title: Reallocate token account
instructions.rationale: Resizes a token account for new extensions; the payer SOL funds the extra rent, a small amount bounded by the extension sizes.
instructions.notes: Tag 29 (TokenInstruction::Reallocate). Extension types (2 bytes each) follow the tag. The owner signs and the payer transfers lamports through the System program when more rent is needed (program/src/extension/reallocate.rs). No amount field, so the spend cannot be capped; denied by default. Accounts: account (w), payer (w,s), System program, owner (s).

instructions.name: enable_memo_transfers
instructions.title: Memo transfers: enable
instructions.rationale: Account setting: requires a memo on incoming transfers into the token account; owner-signed configuration.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 30 (TokenInstruction::MemoTransferExtension) + sub-tag 0 (RequiredMemoTransfersInstruction::Enable); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Adds the MemoTransfer extension if missing. Accounts: account (w), owner (s).

instructions.name: disable_memo_transfers
instructions.title: Memo transfers: disable
instructions.rationale: Account setting: stops requiring a memo on incoming transfers, removing a receive-side protection; owner-signed configuration.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 30 (TokenInstruction::MemoTransferExtension) + sub-tag 1 (RequiredMemoTransfersInstruction::Disable); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Accounts: account (w), owner (s).

instructions.name: create_native_mint
instructions.title: Create native mint
instructions.rationale: One-time permissionless creation of the native (wrapped SOL) mint; the funder pays a fixed rent top-up.
instructions.notes: Tag 31 (TokenInstruction::CreateNativeMint). No instruction data. The program requires the account to be the fixed native mint address and the funder pays the rent difference through the System program. Never needed per agent; denied by default. Accounts: funder (w,s), native mint (w), System program.

instructions.name: initialize_non_transferable_mint
instructions.title: Initialize non-transferable mint
instructions.rationale: Marks a new mint as non-transferable, permanently blocking token transfers; mint-level setup before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Tag 32 (TokenInstruction::InitializeNonTransferableMint). No instruction data. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: initialize_interest_bearing_mint
instructions.title: Interest-bearing: initialize
instructions.rationale: Sets the interest rate and rate authority on a new mint; mint-level setup before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 33 (TokenInstruction::InterestBearingMintExtension) + sub-tag 0 (InterestBearingMintInstruction::Initialize); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: update_rate_interest_bearing_mint
instructions.title: Interest-bearing: update rate
instructions.rationale: Changes the interest rate of a mint; requires the rate authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 33 (TokenInstruction::InterestBearingMintExtension) + sub-tag 1 (InterestBearingMintInstruction::UpdateRate); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data: BasisPoints @2. Accounts: mint (w), rate authority (s).

instructions.name: enable_cpi_guard
instructions.title: CPI guard: enable
instructions.rationale: Enables CPI Guard on a token account, restricting owner-signed transfers, burns, approvals and closes made via CPI; can break relayed execution.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 34 (TokenInstruction::CpiGuardExtension) + sub-tag 0 (CpiGuardInstruction::Enable); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Per the source docs, while enabled: Transfer and Burn must go through a delegate, CloseAccount can only return lamports to the owner, SetAuthority can only remove an existing close authority, and Approve is disallowed. CPI Guard cannot be enabled or disabled via CPI. Accounts: account (w), owner (s).

instructions.name: disable_cpi_guard
instructions.title: CPI guard: disable
instructions.rationale: Disables CPI Guard on a token account, removing its protection against cross-program transfers, burns, approvals and closes.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 34 (TokenInstruction::CpiGuardExtension) + sub-tag 1 (CpiGuardInstruction::Disable); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Cannot be invoked via CPI (source docs), so a CPI relay cannot toggle it. Implicitly initializes the extension if absent. Accounts: account (w), owner (s).

instructions.name: initialize_permanent_delegate
instructions.title: Initialize permanent delegate
instructions.rationale: Sets a permanent delegate on a new mint that can transfer or burn tokens in any holder account; unrestricted control.
instructions.notes: Tag 35 (TokenInstruction::InitializePermanentDelegate). Delegate pubkey @1..33; must run before initialize_mint. Per source docs the delegate may sign for Transfers and Burns on any account of the mint. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: initialize_transfer_hook
instructions.title: Transfer hook: initialize
instructions.rationale: Sets the transfer-hook program and its authority on a new mint, before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 36 (TokenInstruction::TransferHookExtension) + sub-tag 0 (TransferHookInstruction::Initialize); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data: authority and hook program id. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: update_transfer_hook
instructions.title: Transfer hook: update
instructions.rationale: Changes the transfer-hook program id of a mint; requires the transfer hook authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 36 (TokenInstruction::TransferHookExtension) + sub-tag 1 (TransferHookInstruction::Update); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w), transfer hook authority (s).

instructions.name: initialize_confidential_transfer_fee
instructions.title: Confidential transfer fee: initialize
instructions.rationale: Sets the confidential fee authority and withdraw-withheld ElGamal key on a new mint; setup before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 37 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 0 (ConfidentialTransferFeeInstruction::InitializeConfidentialTransferFeeConfig); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: withdraw_withheld_tokens_from_mint_for_confidential_transfer_fee
instructions.title: Confidential transfer fee: withdraw withheld from mint
instructions.rationale: Withdraws all confidential fees withheld on the mint to any fee-receiver account; amounts encrypted; needs the withdraw-withheld authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 37 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 1 (ConfidentialTransferFeeInstruction::WithdrawWithheldTokensFromMint); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Needs a ZK proof instruction or context account. No plaintext amount, so it cannot be capped; denied by default. Accounts: mint (w), fee receiver (w), proof, withdraw-withheld authority (s). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: withdraw_withheld_tokens_from_accounts_for_confidential_transfer_fee
instructions.title: Confidential transfer fee: withdraw withheld from accounts
instructions.rationale: Withdraws all confidential fees withheld on listed token accounts to any fee-receiver account; amounts encrypted; needs the withdraw-withheld authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 37 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 2 (ConfidentialTransferFeeInstruction::WithdrawWithheldTokensFromAccounts); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Needs a ZK proof instruction or context account. No plaintext amount, so it cannot be capped; denied by default. Accounts: mint, fee receiver (w), proof, withdraw-withheld authority (s), sources (w). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: harvest_withheld_tokens_to_mint_for_confidential_transfer_fee
instructions.title: Confidential transfer fee: harvest withheld to mint
instructions.rationale: Permissionless: moves confidential fees withheld on token accounts into the mint; no owner funds are affected.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 37 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 3 (ConfidentialTransferFeeInstruction::HarvestWithheldTokensToMint); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts lacking the required extensions are skipped. Accounts: mint (w), source token accounts (w). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: enable_harvest_to_mint
instructions.title: Confidential transfer fee: enable harvest to mint
instructions.rationale: Lets the mint accept harvested confidential fees; requires the confidential transfer fee authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 37 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 4 (ConfidentialTransferFeeInstruction::EnableHarvestToMint); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Accounts: mint (w), confidential transfer fee authority (s).

instructions.name: disable_harvest_to_mint
instructions.title: Confidential transfer fee: disable harvest to mint
instructions.rationale: Stops the mint from accepting harvested confidential fees; requires the confidential transfer fee authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 37 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialTransferFeeExtension) + sub-tag 5 (ConfidentialTransferFeeInstruction::DisableHarvestToMint); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Accounts: mint (w), confidential transfer fee authority (s).

instructions.name: withdraw_excess_lamports
instructions.title: Withdraw excess lamports
instructions.rationale: Sends all lamports above the rent reserve out of a mint, token account or multisig to any destination; token balances are untouched.
instructions.notes: Tag 38 (TokenInstruction::WithdrawExcessLamports). No instruction data, so no amount can be capped: everything above the rent-exempt minimum moves. Native (wrapped SOL) token accounts are rejected. Authority is the token account owner, the mint authority or the multisig itself. Denied by default because it cannot be amount-limited. Accounts: source (w), destination (w), authority (s).

instructions.name: initialize_metadata_pointer
instructions.title: Metadata pointer: initialize
instructions.rationale: Sets the metadata pointer address and authority on a new mint, before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 39 (TokenInstruction::MetadataPointerExtension) + sub-tag 0 (MetadataPointerInstruction::Initialize); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: update_metadata_pointer
instructions.title: Metadata pointer: update
instructions.rationale: Changes the metadata address a mint points to; requires the metadata pointer authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 39 (TokenInstruction::MetadataPointerExtension) + sub-tag 1 (MetadataPointerInstruction::Update); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w), metadata pointer authority (s).

instructions.name: initialize_group_pointer
instructions.title: Group pointer: initialize
instructions.rationale: Sets the group pointer address and authority on a new mint, before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 40 (TokenInstruction::GroupPointerExtension) + sub-tag 0 (GroupPointerInstruction::Initialize); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: update_group_pointer
instructions.title: Group pointer: update
instructions.rationale: Changes the group address a mint points to; requires the group pointer authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 40 (TokenInstruction::GroupPointerExtension) + sub-tag 1 (GroupPointerInstruction::Update); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w), group pointer authority (s).

instructions.name: initialize_group_member_pointer
instructions.title: Group member pointer: initialize
instructions.rationale: Sets the group member pointer address and authority on a new mint, before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 41 (TokenInstruction::GroupMemberPointerExtension) + sub-tag 0 (GroupMemberPointerInstruction::Initialize); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: update_group_member_pointer
instructions.title: Group member pointer: update
instructions.rationale: Changes the group member address a mint points to; requires the group member pointer authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 41 (TokenInstruction::GroupMemberPointerExtension) + sub-tag 1 (GroupMemberPointerInstruction::Update); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w), group member pointer authority (s).

instructions.name: initialize_confidential_mint_burn
instructions.title: Confidential mint/burn: initialize
instructions.rationale: Enables confidential minting and burning on a new mint with a supply ElGamal key; setup before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 42 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialMintBurnExtension) + sub-tag 0 (ConfidentialMintBurnInstruction::InitializeMint); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: rotate_supply_elgamal_pubkey
instructions.title: Confidential mint/burn: rotate supply ElGamal key
instructions.rationale: Rotates the ElGamal key that encrypts the confidential supply; requires the confidential mint authority and a proof.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 42 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialMintBurnExtension) + sub-tag 1 (ConfidentialMintBurnInstruction::RotateSupplyElGamalPubkey); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data: new supply ElGamal pubkey and a proof instruction offset. Accounts: mint (w), proof, confidential mint authority (s). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: update_confidential_mint_burn_decryptable_supply
instructions.title: Confidential mint/burn: update decryptable supply
instructions.rationale: Updates the decryptable confidential supply value of a mint; requires the confidential mint authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 42 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialMintBurnExtension) + sub-tag 2 (ConfidentialMintBurnInstruction::UpdateDecryptableSupply); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w), confidential mint authority (s).

instructions.name: confidential_mint
instructions.title: Confidential mint/burn: mint
instructions.rationale: Issuer power: mints tokens into a confidential balance with an encrypted amount that cannot be capped; requires the mint authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 42 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialMintBurnExtension) + sub-tag 3 (ConfidentialMintBurnInstruction::Mint); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data carries ciphertexts and proof offsets only, so no amount is readable; denied by default. Accounts: token account (w), mint (w), proofs, mint authority (s). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: confidential_burn
instructions.title: Confidential mint/burn: burn
instructions.rationale: Burns tokens from the signer confidential balance; the amount is encrypted so it cannot be read or capped.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 42 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialMintBurnExtension) + sub-tag 4 (ConfidentialMintBurnInstruction::Burn); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data carries ciphertexts and proof offsets only, so a limit cannot be enforced; denied by default. Accounts: token account (w), mint (w), proofs, owner (s). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: apply_confidential_pending_burn
instructions.title: Confidential mint/burn: apply pending burn
instructions.rationale: Applies the pending burn amount to the confidential supply; requires the mint authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 42 (TokenInstruction::ConfidentialMintBurnExtension) + sub-tag 5 (ConfidentialMintBurnInstruction::ApplyPendingBurn); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w), mint authority (s). Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: initialize_scaled_ui_amount_mint
instructions.title: Scaled UI amount: initialize
instructions.rationale: Sets a UI amount multiplier and its authority on a new mint; setup before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 43 (TokenInstruction::ScaledUiAmountExtension) + sub-tag 0 (ScaledUiAmountMintInstruction::Initialize); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: update_multiplier_scaled_ui_mint
instructions.title: Scaled UI amount: update multiplier
instructions.rationale: Changes the UI amount multiplier of a mint from a given time; requires the multiplier authority; changes displayed balances.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 43 (TokenInstruction::ScaledUiAmountExtension) + sub-tag 1 (ScaledUiAmountMintInstruction::UpdateMultiplier); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data: new multiplier and the UNIX timestamp it takes effect (a past timestamp applies it immediately). Accounts: mint (w), multiplier authority (s).

instructions.name: initialize_pausable_config
instructions.title: Pausable: initialize
instructions.rationale: Sets a pause authority on a new mint so minting, burning and transfers can later be paused; setup before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 44 (TokenInstruction::PausableExtension) + sub-tag 0 (PausableInstruction::Initialize); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: pause
instructions.title: Pausable: pause
instructions.rationale: Pauses minting, burning and transferring for the whole mint; requires the pause authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 44 (TokenInstruction::PausableExtension) + sub-tag 1 (PausableInstruction::Pause); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Accounts: mint (w), pause authority (s).

instructions.name: resume
instructions.title: Pausable: resume
instructions.rationale: Resumes minting, burning and transferring for a paused mint; requires the pause authority.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 44 (TokenInstruction::PausableExtension) + sub-tag 2 (PausableInstruction::Resume); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. No data after the sub-tag. Accounts: mint (w), pause authority (s).

instructions.name: unwrap_lamports
instructions.title: Unwrap lamports
instructions.rationale: Moves lamports out of a native (wrapped SOL) token account to any destination; omitting the amount moves the whole balance.
instructions.notes: Tag 45 (TokenInstruction::UnwrapLamports). Data is an optional amount: option flag u8 @1, then a u64 LE amount @2 ONLY when the flag is 1. Flag 0 moves the ENTIRE balance and the program ignores any trailing bytes (decode_instruction_data_with_coption_u64), so a reader that trusts offset 2 without checking byte 1 == 1 can be bypassed; for that reason amount is null here (treat flag 0 as unbounded). The source must be a native token account; a delegate is limited to its delegated amount. Denied by default. Accounts: source (w), destination (w), owner or delegate (s).

instructions.name: initialize_permissioned_burn
instructions.title: Permissioned burn: initialize
instructions.rationale: Requires a designated authority to co-sign burns of a new mint; setup before initialize_mint.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 46 (TokenInstruction::PermissionedBurnExtension) + sub-tag 0 (PermissionedBurnInstruction::Initialize); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data: the authority pubkey @2..34. Accounts: mint (w).

instructions.name: permissioned_burn
instructions.title: Permissioned burn: burn
instructions.rationale: Burns tokens from an account of a permissioned-burn mint; needs the permissioned burn authority and the owner or delegate to sign.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 46 (TokenInstruction::PermissionedBurnExtension) + sub-tag 1 (PermissionedBurnInstruction::Burn); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Layout: amount u64 @2. Accounts: source (w), mint (w), permissioned burn authority (s), owner or delegate (s).

instructions.name: permissioned_burn_checked
instructions.title: Permissioned burn: burn (checked)
instructions.rationale: Burns tokens from an account of a permissioned-burn mint, verifying decimals; needs the burn authority and the owner or delegate to sign.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 46 (TokenInstruction::PermissionedBurnExtension) + sub-tag 2 (PermissionedBurnInstruction::BurnChecked); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Layout: amount u64 @2, decimals u8 @10. Accounts: source (w), mint (w), permissioned burn authority (s), owner or delegate (s).

instructions.name: permissioned_confidential_burn
instructions.title: Permissioned burn: confidential burn
instructions.rationale: Burns tokens from the confidential balance of a permissioned-burn mint; the amount is encrypted so it cannot be read or capped.
instructions.notes: Extension tag 46 (TokenInstruction::PermissionedBurnExtension) + sub-tag 3 (PermissionedBurnInstruction::ConfidentialBurn); 2-byte prefix, disc8 = both bytes + 6 zero bytes. Data carries ciphertexts and proof offsets only, so a limit cannot be enforced; denied by default. Compiled behind the zk-ops build feature (a default feature of program@v11.0.0 and v11.1.0); runtime availability also depends on the cluster ZK ElGamal proof program and was not verified.

instructions.name: batch
instructions.title: Batch
instructions.rationale: Executes a sequence of nested token instructions, including transfers and authority changes, hidden from a per-instruction allowlist.
instructions.notes: Tag 255 (TokenInstruction::Batch). After the tag the data repeats [num_accounts u8][data_len u8][nested instruction data starting with its own tag]; accounts for the nested instructions follow in order and the outer signers authorize them. Nested instructions can be any base or extension instruction; a nested batch is rejected. A per-instruction allowlist or amount limit cannot see inside, so allowing batch effectively allows everything it can contain. Classed other with defaultDeny: its risk is the union of the nested instructions.

instructions.name: initialize_token_metadata
instructions.title: Token metadata: initialize
instructions.rationale: Writes name, symbol and URI metadata into a mint and assigns its update authority; requires the mint authority.
instructions.notes: spl-token-metadata-interface v1.0.1 TokenMetadataInstruction::Initialize: 8-byte discriminator = sha256("spl_token_metadata_interface:initialize_account")[0..8], equal to the IDL bytes; rawPrefixHex = disc8. Borsh data after the discriminator: name, symbol, uri (u32 length-prefixed strings). Requires the MetadataPointer extension; the mint account itself holds the metadata. Resizes the account but moves no lamports, so it must be pre-funded. Accounts: metadata (the mint) (w), update authority, mint, mint authority (s).

instructions.name: update_token_metadata_field
instructions.title: Token metadata: update field
instructions.rationale: Changes the name, symbol, URI or a custom field of token metadata; requires the update authority; can alter token identity.
instructions.notes: spl-token-metadata-interface v1.0.1 TokenMetadataInstruction::UpdateField: 8-byte discriminator = sha256("spl_token_metadata_interface:updating_field")[0..8], equal to the IDL bytes; rawPrefixHex = disc8. Borsh data: Field enum (Name, Symbol, Uri, Key(string)) and a value string. Resizes the account but moves no lamports. Accounts: metadata (w), update authority (s).

instructions.name: remove_token_metadata_key
instructions.title: Token metadata: remove key
instructions.rationale: Removes a custom key from token metadata; requires the update authority.
instructions.notes: spl-token-metadata-interface v1.0.1 TokenMetadataInstruction::RemoveKey: 8-byte discriminator = sha256("spl_token_metadata_interface:remove_key_ix")[0..8], equal to the IDL bytes; rawPrefixHex = disc8. Borsh data: idempotent bool, key string. Accounts: metadata (w), update authority (s).

instructions.name: update_token_metadata_update_authority
instructions.title: Token metadata: update authority
instructions.rationale: Transfers or clears the token-metadata update authority; clearing makes the metadata immutable.
instructions.notes: spl-token-metadata-interface v1.0.1 TokenMetadataInstruction::UpdateAuthority: 8-byte discriminator = sha256("spl_token_metadata_interface:update_the_authority")[0..8], equal to the IDL bytes; rawPrefixHex = disc8. Data: new authority (nullable pubkey). Accounts: metadata (w), current update authority (s).

instructions.name: emit_token_metadata
instructions.title: Token metadata: emit
instructions.rationale: Query only: returns token metadata through return data; changes no state.
instructions.notes: spl-token-metadata-interface v1.0.1 TokenMetadataInstruction::Emit: 8-byte discriminator = sha256("spl_token_metadata_interface:emitter")[0..8], equal to the IDL bytes; rawPrefixHex = disc8. Borsh data: optional start and end of the byte range. Accounts: metadata.

instructions.name: initialize_token_group
instructions.title: Token group: initialize group
instructions.rationale: Creates a token group on a mint with an update authority and a maximum size; requires the mint authority.
instructions.notes: spl-token-group-interface v0.7.2 TokenGroupInstruction::InitializeGroup: 8-byte discriminator = sha256("spl_token_group_interface:initialize_token_group")[0..8], equal to the IDL bytes; rawPrefixHex = disc8. Data: update authority (nullable pubkey) and max size u64. Accounts: group (w), mint, mint authority (s).

instructions.name: update_token_group_max_size
instructions.title: Token group: update max size
instructions.rationale: Changes the maximum size of a token group; requires the group update authority.
instructions.notes: spl-token-group-interface v0.7.2 TokenGroupInstruction::UpdateGroupMaxSize: 8-byte discriminator = sha256("spl_token_group_interface:update_group_max_size")[0..8], equal to the IDL bytes; rawPrefixHex = disc8. Data: max size u64. Accounts: group (w), update authority (s).

instructions.name: update_token_group_update_authority
instructions.title: Token group: update authority
instructions.rationale: Transfers or clears the token-group update authority.
instructions.notes: spl-token-group-interface v0.7.2 TokenGroupInstruction::UpdateGroupAuthority: 8-byte discriminator = sha256("spl_token_group_interface:update_authority")[0..8], equal to the IDL bytes; rawPrefixHex = disc8. Data: new authority (nullable pubkey). Accounts: group (w), current update authority (s).

instructions.name: initialize_token_group_member
instructions.title: Token group: initialize member
instructions.rationale: Adds a mint as a member of a token group; requires the member mint authority and the group update authority.
instructions.notes: spl-token-group-interface v0.7.2 TokenGroupInstruction::InitializeMember: 8-byte discriminator = sha256("spl_token_group_interface:initialize_member")[0..8], equal to the IDL bytes; rawPrefixHex = disc8. No data after the discriminator. Accounts: member (w), member mint, member mint authority (s), group (w), group update authority (s).
